instance.selection: Use target/environment mapping in owner SKILL; never enumerate unrelated profiles or silently fall back.
instance.currentVersion: unknown; historical values are not runtime evidence
instance.addressEvidence: Owner SKILL.md environment tables are the address SSOT; credential variables and exceptions in auth.nativeCredentialPath are selected-instance constraints.

auth.nativeCredentialPath: SUPERSET_URL=https://superset-us.addx.live; service account SUPERSET_USER (canonical; SUPERSET_USERNAME only if unset)/SUPERSET_PASSWORD; SUPERSET_EXPECTED_USER enforces selected service identity and mismatch stops before network produces JWT via /api/v1/security/login. login2 service-account browser route is distinct.
auth.missingCredentialWorkflow: Service account may use login2 with CSRF/Referer/User-Agent/same cookie jar per local reference. Personal users use SSO; redirect from login2 to /login/ is failure and never automatic fallback.
auth.subjectAndResourcePermissionVerification: GET /api/v1/me/ when available and authorized chart/dashboard metadata; target API/page readability verifies session. Confirm roles and database dataset access; CSRF token is not identity.
auth.issuanceConsumptionRevocation: JWT expiry from actual response/config; renew only approved service account flow. Session logout and JWT expiry are distinct; no universal JWT revoke endpoint established.
auth.credentialHandling: Private injection only; never print/store secrets in repository, command arguments, chat or receipts. Discovery itself performs no login/token creation.

nativeRoute.loginRecovery: web-access for human web interaction; official CLI only where explicitly documented
